info.name: Retrieve data observations from an IMF dataset

params.name: agency
params.description: The agency owning the dataflow (e.g., IMF.STA, all)

params.name: dataflow_id
params.description: The dataflow identifier (e.g., IFS, GFS, FM, WEO, MFS, BOP)

params.name: key
params.description: Dot-separated dimension key with + for multiple values and * for wildcard

params.name: dimensionAtObservation
params.description: Specify which dimension varies at the observation level

params.name: attributes
params.description: Level of attribute detail to include in response

params.name: c[TIME_PERIOD]
params.description:
Time period filter using SDMX comparison operators.
Format: ge:YYYY-{freq}N+le:YYYY-{freq}N
Examples: ge:2010-A1+le:2020-A1 (annual), ge:2010-Q1+le:2020-Q4 (quarterly)

items.docs:
Returns time-series data observations for the specified dataflow filtered
by the dimension key. The key is a dot-separated string where each position
corresponds to a dimension in the dataset's data structure definition (DSD),
in positional order. Use '+' to specify multiple values for a dimension and
'*' or blank to wildcard a dimension.

Examples:
- `A.USA.PCPI` - Annual, USA, Consumer Price Index
- `A+Q.USA+GBR.*` - Annual and Quarterly, USA and UK, all indicators
- `*.*.NGDP_RPCH` - All freq
